homotopy_class_compare — DRIVE braidpath op

• Data kinds: any × any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.homotopy_class_compare(traj_a, traj_b, obstacles=None, angle=0.1, jitter='auto', tol=1e-09) (to call the implementation directly, import braidpath; braidpath.homotopy_class_compare(traj_a, traj_b, obstacles=None, angle=0.1, jitter='auto', tol=1e-09); from the registry, opsdrive.get("homotopy_class_compare"))

Usage

Whether two path families with the same start and end points (multi-agent plans) are in the same homotopy class.

Can be deformed continuously without collision (no overlap between agents or with obstacle points) while start and end points stay fixed ⇔ the braids are equal. The braid comes from braid_from_trajectories, the comparison uses Dynnikov coordinates. Independent of the projection angle (the gate sweeps several angles).

Returns: dict same, word_a / word_b, key_a / key_b, quotient (the reduced word of a b⁻¹ —— empty means the same class; otherwise a word describing “how the windings differ”), endpoint_error (largest deviation of the start and end points). Start and end points must agree within tol (default ENDPOINT_TOL = 1e-9, in coordinate units). tol is a gate that only passes / rejects without changing the answer, and is listed with its reason in the ledger of knobs with no effect. If the endpoints of different planners differ by rounding, widen tol or align the endpoints before comparing (the class is the class of deformations with fixed endpoints, so two plans with different endpoints cannot be compared).

Raises: ValueError (different number of agents, start or end points farther apart than tol, tol negative or non-finite, collision).
